name: Spark Savings USDC
oneLiner: spUSDC is Spark's ERC-4626 V2 savings wrapper of USDC; share price compounds the Vault Savings Rate while exits redeem from vault USDC liquidity.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: spUSDC resolves to Upstream because the wrapper holds USDC as its only reserve, inheriting Circle's blacklist surface.

collateral: USDC deposited into Spark Savings Vault V2 (ERC-4626 asset=USDC); idle USDC is deployed by the Spark Liquidity Layer. Spark documents V2 USD vaults as economically fully backed by USDS / Sky balance-sheet liquidity for redemptions.
pegMechanism: Deposit USDC to mint spUSDC; share price appreciates against USDC as the Vault Savings Rate (vsr) accrues while SLL deploys idle assets. Withdrawals burn spUSDC for USDC subject to vault idle liquidity or Savings Liquidity Intents for large exits.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Spark materials describe an ERC-4626 savings wrapper with USDC and Sky liquidity-layer exposure, but the complete current deployment-wide assurance, custody, valuation, reconciliation, and recovery semantics needed to resolve the mechanism archetype are not disclosed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Spark Savings USDC is tracked on Ethereum and Avalanche as a wrapper/variant of USDC. On-chain reads on 2026-07-20 confirm both deployments are local Spark ERC-4626 savings vaults over local USDC (immutable clones, zero proxy admin), so issuance is native per chain with inherited USDC exposure.

At Avalanche block 87752284: impl slot = 0xc2c0582d1cce30449cf561c7b9c4d6d527547f12 (also UUPS). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member[0] = 0x7566debc906c17338524a414343fa61bca26a843 (8113 bytes of code). 2026-07-20 follow-up resolved both prior open questions via the Spark address registry (sparkdotfi/spark-address-registry): the Ethereum admin is SPARK_PROXY, the Spark DAO SubProxy whose payloads execute through Sky/Spark governance approval (token-holder governance, no fixed signer set, governed by the Sky governance security flow), and the Avalanche admin is SPARK_EXECUTOR (spark-gov-relay/Executor.sol v1.0.1), Spark's cross-chain governance executor driven from Ethereum mainnet through the LZReceiver 0xd905be48983D405C6fD7f5a983D2351fb61C691F.
